2026-10-15.title: Lost in you and healed by him
2026-10-15.message: Could you make my little universe more brighter with just one hello?        •Being far from you, I lost my self. A part of my heart became against to you, why? My heart wants to meet you, why does it want to meet you? Like the glow of stars, light up this night. Explain to my heart, keep your hand in mine. What I've never seen before, show me such a world.
